title: Variables, Mutability & Control Flow
objectives: Distinguish immutable bindings, mut, and shadowing
Choose scalar vs compound types deliberately
Write if/match/loop control flow that returns values

examples.name: control_flow.rs

exercise.prompt: FizzBuzz from 1..=15 using match on `(n % 3, n % 5)`. Print one item per line.
hints: String literals are fine arms — arms must share one type.
